notes.subject: הערקים
notes.rationale: שורש ערק i tok 'ranawe'; KJV 'ranawe i go long ples wail' vs ASV/JPS 'ol i kaikai graun drau' — mi bihainim kaikai

notes.subject: שואה ומשאה
notes.rationale: Tupela tok i klostu wankain long nois — שואה (bagarap olgeta) na משאה (nogat mani) — mitupela tok i tanim klostu, tasol pilai bilong leta i lus long Tok Pisin

notes.subject: אמש
notes.rationale: Sampela i tanim 'long taim bipo' (KJV), mi bihainim mining stat 'asde nait'

translation: Long no gat samting na long hangre, ol i nogat man olgeta; ol i kaikai graun drau, long ples bilong asde nait i raunraum na nogat mani olgeta.
